title: LatentRefusal: Latent-Signal Refusal for Unanswerable Text-to-SQL Queries
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical methods for safe deployment of Text-to-SQL systems by preventing incorrect or harmful SQL generation from unanswerable queries. While 'safety' is a key theme, it primarily relates to data integrity, preventing privacy violations, or avoiding costly operational incidents caused by semantically unfaithful executable programs. It does not directly evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component.
